info.title: style.id API
info.description: Measurement-based fit for tops: closet, body, products, fit reports.

patch.description:
Merge the given per-zone shifts into the stored preferences. Send ``0`` to reset a
zone. The engine nudges these automatically from purchase outcomes.

post.description:
Record how the user moved the proposed flat-lay landmarks; training data for the
landmark model.
Store a new body record and make it the current one.
The user looked at the numbers and accepted them, overriding any they corrected.

Canonicalise the URL, find or create the product, and make sure a size chart has
been extracted (or is being extracted). Idempotent for the same product.
